basic.name: 普通攻击：霄云劲
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成玄墨伤害，
招式第三段与第四段期间抗打断等级提升。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five attacks forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
This skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

special.name: 特殊技：烬影诀
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速后撤后向前方发动攻击，造成玄墨伤害；
后撤期间可触发极限闪避效果，但不能衔接闪避反击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Swiftly retreat, then attack forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
While retreating, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Dodge Counter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：墨痕化形
ex.trigger: 闪能足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
闪能足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
持续蓄力，松开 【强化特殊技键】 时发动翅膀上挑攻击，造成大量玄墨伤害；
蓄力期间，若受到敌人攻击，则可自动格挡并触发翅膀上挑攻击；
蓄力开始瞬间受到敌人攻击时，可触发完美格挡效果，免疫该次伤害，提高招式的打断等级至与重招架支援一致，回复10点闪能；
翅膀上挑攻击命中出现红色闪光或黄色闪光的敌人时，也可触发完美格挡效果，免疫该次伤害，提高招式的打断等级至与重招架支援一致，回复10点闪能；
完美格挡效果每0.5秒最多触发一次；
若蓄力至闪光或触发完美格挡效果，则翅膀上挑攻击后可额外追加符箓攻击；
招式发动后，可点按 【特殊技键】 发动[强化特殊技：霄云迅击-破]；
发动[强化特殊技：霄云迅击-破]后，若闪能足够，可点按 【强化特殊技键】 额外消耗20点闪能发动[强化特殊技：青溟震击-破]；
[强化特殊技：青溟震击-破]发动后，若[玄墨值]足够，长按 【闪避键】 可快速衔接[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]；
翅膀上挑攻击时拥有无敌效果，蓄力期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Charge continuously, and release [EX Special Attack] to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press [Special Attack] to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

facts.text:
仪玄会额外根据自身最大生命值提高贯穿力，每1点最大生命值将提高0.1点贯穿力；
仪玄发动招式造成的玄墨伤害均为贯穿伤害，无视敌人防御，使用贯穿力作为招式伤害倍率；
仪玄累积玄墨异常积蓄值时，具有独立的属性异常积蓄槽，触发属性异常效果时，额外回复10点闪能，每10秒最多触发一次；
仪玄进入战斗时即可恢复全部闪能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，触发极限闪避时额外回复5点闪能，每1秒最多触发一次；
消耗闪能时，仪玄会积累[术法值]，每消耗一点闪能，积累0.667点[术法值]，[术法值]足够时，可额外释放终结技：[终结技：符法千重]，[术法值]上限为120点；
仪玄施展[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]、[普通攻击：青溟震击]、[强化特殊技]、[支援突击]、[连携技]、[终结技]造成的伤害提升60%；
释放[终结技：符法千重]后，仪玄获得一点[玄墨值]，仪玄可消耗一点[玄墨值]，释放[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]。
facts.textEn:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Auric Ink DMG Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by 60%.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.

cinema.name: 清灵道心
cinema.description: 进入战场时，暴击率提升10%，立即获得120点[术法值]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；队伍中任意角色命中敌人时，仪玄会自动追加一道落雷，造成等同于仪玄50%贯穿力的伤害并额外回复5点闪能，6秒内最多追加一次落雷。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering combat, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 Technique Points. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.

cinema.name: 消灾渡厄
cinema.description: [终结技]或[强化特殊技]造成伤害时，无视目标15%以太伤害抗性；发动[终结技：青溟云影]时，使所有处于失衡状态的敌人失衡持续时间提升3秒，敌人在一次失衡期间内只会受到一次该效果，且同类效果不可叠加；此外，发动[终结技：符法千重]时，获得一层[聚墨]效果，发动[普通攻击：青溟震击]、[强化特殊技：墨烬影消]后点按普通攻击键，发动[强化特殊技：青溟震击-破]后点按特殊技键，可消耗一层[聚墨]发动[强化特殊技：符法千重-破]，最多造成等同于1200%贯穿力的伤害，[聚墨]效果最多维持一层。
cinema.descriptionEn: When an Ultimate or EX Special Attack deals DMG, it ignores 15% of the target's Ether RES. Triggering Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade extends all enemies' Stunned state by 3s. In a single Stun state duration, enemies can only have this effect applied once, and it does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, when using Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, gain one stack of the Condensed Ink effect. After Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption or EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows, press the Basic Attack button, or after EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break, press the Special Attack button to consume one stack of Condensed Ink and launch EX Special Attack: Endless Talisman Suppression - Break, dealing DMG up to 1,200% of Sheer Force. Only one stack of Condensed Ink can be held at a time.

cinema.descriptionEn: Activating an  Ultimate grants one stack of Tranquility, up to a max of 2 stacks. For each stack of Tranquility, the next EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper DMG and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows DMG increase by 30%.

cinema.name: 静观流云
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 动静相宜
cinema.description: 发动[终结技：青溟云影]后，获得一层[调息]效果，[调息]状态下，可无视[术法值]发动一次[终结技：符法千重]，发动[终结技：符法千重]后[调息]状态结束，该效果每30秒最多获得一次，[调息]效果最多维持一层；此外，[凝神]状态下，仪玄的贯穿伤害提高20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After using Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade, gain a stack of the Regulated Breathing effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the Technique Point cost to launch Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression once. The Regulated Breathing effect ends after Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of Regulated Breathing can be held. Additionally, while in the Meditation state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：霄云劲
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成玄墨伤害，
招式第三段与第四段期间抗打断等级提升。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five attacks forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
This skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

basic.name: 普通攻击：墨影凝云
basic.description:
长按 【闪避键】 发动：
展开大太极阵，造成玄墨伤害；
招式结束时自动释放[普通攻击：霄云劲]第五段攻击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
basic.descriptionEn:
Hold [Dodge] to activate:
Deploy a Grand Tai Chi Formation, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, automatically launch the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：玄墨极阵
basic.description:
拥有[玄墨值]时在[闪避：清霄同游]招式期间点按 【普通攻击键】 或拥有[玄墨值]时长按 【闪避键】 发动：
展开阵法，持续造成玄墨伤害；
招式结束时自动释放[普通攻击：青溟震击]；
动作持续引导期间，持续回复闪能，每秒回复7点，最多3秒；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果且进入极限视域状态。
basic.descriptionEn:
While possessing an Auric Ink Point: tap [Basic Attack] during Dodge: Nimbus Step, or hold [Dodge] to activate:
Deploy an array, continuously dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, it automatically triggers Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption.
While channeling, continuously recover Adrenaline, recovering 7/s, for up to 3s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, and enters the Vital View state.

basic.name: 普通攻击：青溟震击
basic.description:
发动[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]达到最大时长自动释放：
张开翅膀发动爆炸攻击，造成大量玄墨伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
Automatically activates when Basic Attack: Auric Array reaches the max duration:
Spreads her wings to launch an explosive attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：凌云破
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突进攻击，造成玄墨伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch a forward rush attack, dealing Auric Ink DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：烬影诀
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速后撤后向前方发动攻击，造成玄墨伤害；
后撤期间可触发极限闪避效果，但不能衔接闪避反击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Swiftly retreat, then attack forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
While retreating, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Dodge Counter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：墨痕化形
ex.description:
闪能足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
持续蓄力，松开 【强化特殊技键】 时发动翅膀上挑攻击，造成大量玄墨伤害；
蓄力期间，若受到敌人攻击，则可自动格挡并触发翅膀上挑攻击；
蓄力开始瞬间受到敌人攻击时，可触发完美格挡效果，免疫该次伤害，提高招式的打断等级至与重招架支援一致，回复10点闪能；
翅膀上挑攻击命中出现红色闪光或黄色闪光的敌人时，也可触发完美格挡效果，免疫该次伤害，提高招式的打断等级至与重招架支援一致，回复10点闪能；
完美格挡效果每0.5秒最多触发一次；
若蓄力至闪光或触发完美格挡效果，则翅膀上挑攻击后可额外追加符箓攻击；
招式发动后，可点按 【特殊技键】 发动[强化特殊技：霄云迅击-破]；
发动[强化特殊技：霄云迅击-破]后，若闪能足够，可点按 【强化特殊技键】 额外消耗20点闪能发动[强化特殊技：青溟震击-破]；
[强化特殊技：青溟震击-破]发动后，若[玄墨值]足够，长按 【闪避键】 可快速衔接[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]；
翅膀上挑攻击时拥有无敌效果，蓄力期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Charge continuously, and release [EX Special Attack] to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press [Special Attack] to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：凝云术
ex.description:
闪能足够时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
持续蓄力，在敌人身边引导能量汇聚，持续造成伤害，最多持续2秒，造成大量玄墨伤害；
蓄力至最长时间或提前中断后，自动释放[强化特殊技：墨烬影消]；
招式发动瞬间可触发极限闪避，触发极限闪避后可进入极限视域；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Continuously charge up, channeling energy around enemies to deal DMG over time, up to a max of 2s, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Once fully charged or if interrupted, automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows.
At the moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered. After the Perfect Dodge, enter the Vital View state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：墨烬影消
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows
ex.description:
[强化特殊技：凝云术]过程中自动发动：
能量球出现与收缩时，均会造成玄墨伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
Triggers automatically during EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper:
When the energy orb appears and contracts, it deals Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：青溟云影
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
持续发动羽翼攻击，随后引导万千符箓进行攻击，造成大量玄墨伤害；
释放招式时，仪玄会平均分配队伍中角色的生命值；
招式发动后，若[玄墨值]足够，长按 【闪避键】 可快速衔接[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a barrage of wing attacks, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：符法千重
ultimate.description:
[术法值]足够时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
消耗120点[术法值]，张开羽翼，随后引导万千符箓进行攻击，造成大量玄墨伤害；
[术法值]与[喧响值]同时足够时，优先释放该招式；
招式发动后，若[玄墨值]足够，长按 【闪避键】 可快速衔接[普通攻击：玄墨极阵]；
释放招式时，仪玄会平均分配队伍中角色的生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
With enough Technique Points, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Consumes 120 Technique Points to spread her wings, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
With both enough Technique Points and Decibels, this skill triggers with priority.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：流云影身
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击，造成玄墨伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

137100003.name: 普通攻击：玄墨极阵
137100003.description:
